items.statement: Submit completed W-9 form with proposal.
items.quote: Provide a completed W-9 form (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/fw9.pdf), submit with proposal

items.statement: Request debriefing within 15 calendar days of non-selection notification.
items.quote: a debriefing is available upon request made within 15 calendar days of notification
